summary.input: Our library will open a quiet study room next month. The new room will provide twenty desks and reliable Wi-Fi for local students. Visitors can reserve a desk online for up to two hours each day. The library will keep its existing opening hours. Volunteers will offer a weekly workshop on finding trustworthy research sources. The workshop is free, but visitors need to book a place. Staff will review feedback after three months before deciding whether to add more desks.
